title: DroNc-seq step-by-step
protocol: Wash and filter barcoded beads as previously described.
Isolate beads smaller than 40 µm using a 40 µm cell strainer.
Suspend barcoded beads in Drop-seq Lysis Buffer.
Count beads at a 1:1 dilution in a 20% PEG solution using a disposable Fuchs-Rosenthal hemocytometer.
Resuspend beads at concentrations ranging between 325,000 and 350,000 per ml.
Culture cell lines according to ATCC’s instructions.
Wash cells once with 1x PBS for DroNc-seq.
Scrape cells with 2 ml of nuclease- and protease-free Nuclei EZ lysis or EZ PREP buffer.
Preserve tissue samples by flash freezing on dry ice and storing at -80°C.
Place tissue samples in ice-cold RNAlater and store overnight at 4°C.
Remove RNAlater the following day and store samples at -80°C until processing.
Use either fresh, frozen, or RNAlater-fixed tissue or fresh cells as input material.
Prepare Nuclei Suspension Buffer \(NSB\) consisting of 1x PBS, 0.01% BSA, and 0.1% RNAse inhibitor.
Dounce homogenize tissue samples smaller than 0.5 cm or cell pellets in 2 ml of ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer.
For brain tissue: grind 20-25 times with pestle A, followed by 20-25 times with pestle B.
Move the sample to a 15 ml conical tube and add 2 ml of ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Collect nuclei by centrifugation at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and carefully resuspend nuclei in 4 ml of ice-cold Nuclei EZ lysis buffer.
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes.
Collect nuclei by centrifugation at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend isolated nuclei in 4 ml of NSB and collect nuclei by centrifugation at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend isolated nuclei in 1 ml of NSB, and filter through a 35 μm cell strainer.
Stain 10 µl of the single nuclei suspension with DAPI.
Load on an NI hemocytometer and count under a microscope.
A final concentration of 300,000 nuclei/ml is used for DroNc-seq experiments.
Proceed immediately to microfluidic droplet co-encapsulation.
Load the nuclei suspension into a 3 ml syringe.
Connect the nuclei syringe to the DroNc-seq microfluidic chip via a sterile needle and PE2 tubing.
Load the barcoded bead suspension into a 3 ml syringe in an upside-down position with a flea magnet inside for constant stirring.
Connect the bead syringe to the microfluidic chip.
Load carrier oil into additional 10 ml syringes.
Flow nuclei suspensions at 1.5 ml/hr through the chip.
Flow barcoded beads and carrier oil simultaneously, with carrier oil flowing at 16 ml/hr.
Collect resulting emulsion via PE2 tubing into a 50 ml Falcon tube for approximately 22 minutes each period.
Incubate collected emulsion at room temperature for up to 45 min before proceeding.
Break droplets to release encapsulated nuclei and beads.
Proceed with washes after droplet breakage.
Conduct reverse transcription (RT) following washes.
Carefully remove excess clear oil from emulsion collected after microfluidic co-encapsulation.
Add 30 ml of 6x SSC to each 50 ml Falcon collection tube and agitate vigorously.
Add 1 ml of 1H,1H,2H,2H-Perfluorooctan-1-ol to the mixture in each tube.
Vigorously shake the tubes by hand and centrifuge at 1,000 x g for 1 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant from each tube.
Squirt an additional 30 ml of 6x SSC into the tubes to kick up beads from the oil-water interface into the aqueous phase.
Remove the beads that were kicked up momentarily into the SSC with a 25 ml pipette and transfer them into a clean 50 ml Falcon tube, leaving the heavier oil behind.
Centrifuge the newly transferred beads and SSC mix again at 1,000 x g for 1 min.
Carefully remove the supernatant, leaving ~1 ml of SSC and bead sediment behind in each tube.
Transfer remaining SSC and bead mix into a 1.5 ml micro-centrifuge tube.
Spin the 1.5 ml tubes down on a desktop micro-centrifuge for ~10 sec to generate a noticeable bead pellet.
Remove any residual oil that got transferred into the 1.5 ml tube with a p200 pipette using low-retention tips.
Wash the beads in 1.5 ml of 6x SSC.
Wash the beads again in 300 µl of 5x Maxima H-RT buffer.
Make a fresh batch of 200 µl RT mix for each barcoded bead aliquot.
Remove the supernatant from each bead pellet carefully.
Add 200 µl of the RT mix into each tube containing the bead pellet.
Incubate the tubes under gentle rocking or tumbling at room temperature for 30 min.
Continue incubation at 42°C for 1.5 hr in a rotisserie-style hybridization oven.
Wash each STAMP pellet with 1 ml of TE buffer containing 0.5% SDS once.
Wash each STAMP pellet with 1 ml of TE buffer containing 0.01% Tween-20 twice.
Wash each STAMP pellet with 1 ml of 10 mM Tris pH 8.0 once.
Spin down to remove all supernatant.
Add 20 μl of Exo I buffer, 170 μl of RNAse free water, and 10 μl of Exo I enzyme.
Mix well by pipetting up and down.
Incubate for 45 min at 37°C under rotation.
Wash the pellet with TE-SDS.
Wash the pellet with TE-TW.
Wash the pellet with 1 ml of RNAse free water.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL of H2O.
Mix 10 μl of bead suspension with an equal volume of 20% PEG solution.
Resuspend aliquots of 5,000 beads in a PCR mix consisting of 24.6 µl H2O, 0.4 µl 100 µM SMART PCR primer, and 25 µl 2x Kapa HiFi Hotstart Readymix.
Amplify the samples in separate wells on a skirted PCR plate using an Eppendorf Thermocycler.
Perform initial denaturation at 95°C for 3 min.
Cycle through 4 cycles of: 98°C for 20 sec, 65°C for 45 sec, 72°C for 3 min.
Cycle through 10 cycles of: 98°C for 20 sec, 67°C for 20 sec, 72°C for 3 min.
Perform final extension at 72°C for 5 min.
Pool amplified mouse PCR products in batches of 4 wells or 16 wells.
Amplify human PCR samples with the following steps:
Heat to 95°C for 3 min.
Cycle through 4 cycles of: Heat to 98°C for 20 sec, cool to 65°C for 45 sec, heat to 72°C for 3 min.
Cycle through 12 cycles of: Heat to 98°C for 20 sec, cool to 67°C for 20 sec, heat to 72°C for 3 min.
Finally, hold at 72°C for 5 min.
Pool amplified human PCR products in batches of 4 wells or 16 wells based on the total number of PCR cycles required.
Combine 5,000 STAMP aliquots from each well into a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube.
Clean with 0.6X SPRI beads (Ampure XP beads).
Pool 20,000 STAMPs in each PCR reaction for library preparation step.
Pool 4 PCR wells together to prepare the library.
Depending on sequencing yield and desired reads per nucleus, pool a higher number of PCR wells in a single Nextera library.
Quantify purified cDNA using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit and BioAnalyzer High Sensitivity Chip.
Use 550 pg of each sample library for fragmentation, tagging and amplification with the Nextera XT sample prep kit according to manufacturer’s instructions.
Quantify Nextera libraries again with Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit and BioAnalyzer High Sensitivity Chip.
Sequence the libraries on an Illumina NextSeq 500 using NextSeq 75 cycle kits for paired-end reads as follows: 20 bp (Read 1), 60 bp (Read 2), and 8 bp for Index 1.
